qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Mission-critical plant lifecycle and engineering software is sticky once embedded, but pricing power is unproven on a standalone basis outside Hexagon's hardware bundles, and it lacks an audited multi-year standalone ROIC track record while carrying legacy heavy R&D capitalization.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power). Recent 2026 Hexagon software spin-off lacking an audited multi-cycle standalone ROIC track record and carrying Hexagon's legacy of heavy R&D capitalization. Standalone pricing power outside hardware/software bundles remains unproven.
qualitative.evidence: Spun off from Hexagon AB in 2026. Lacks standalone 5-year public financial history to verify median GAAP ROIC >= 12% and owner FCF conversion under standalone cost structure. High historical software capitalization raises uncertainty on true economic returns.
